speaker: Doctor
text: That is a very intense episode. On a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate your current level of confusion or disorientation right now? Also, have you noticed any visual disturbances, such as blurry vision or seeing flashes of light?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Aggressive behavior and irritability. I also have Yelling, Breaking objects, Prolonged physical activity (several hours at the gym), Rapid speech during exam, Aggressiveness during exam.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Serotonin Syndrome

The combination of recent stress, extreme physical exertion, aggression, and current mental status changes strongly suggests Serotonin Syndrome. Please confirm if you have taken any new medications, particularly antidepressants, pain relievers like tramadol, or recreational drugs like MDMA.
